sqlMap.select: SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(refno, 4) AS int)), 0) + 1 FROM t_multilot_tag WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE refno LIKE 'ML' + #value# + '%'
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO t_multilot_tag (refno, customerid, fgid, wip, status, printcount, printername, createby, createdate, updateby, updatedate) VALUES (#refNo#, #customerId#, #fgId#, #wip#, 'A', 1, #printerName#, #updateBy#, GETDATE(), #updateBy#, GETDATE())

insert.iterate: INSERT INTO t_multilot_tag_detail (refno, [lineno], lotseqno, qty, datecode) VALUES (#refNo#, #details[].lineNo#, #details[].lotSeqNo#, #details[].qty#, #details[].dateCode,jdbcType=DATE#);

sqlMap.select: SELECT ml.refno AS refNo , ml.customerid AS customerId , ml.fgid AS fgId , ml.wip , ml.status , ml.printcount AS printCount , ml.printername AS printerName , cust.customername AS customerName , fg.fgno AS fgNo , fg.fgname AS fgName , wip.wipname AS wipName FROM t_multilot_tag ml LEFT JOIN m_customer cust ON cust.customerid = ml.customerid LEFT JOIN m_fg fg ON fg.fgid = ml.fgid LEFT JOIN m_wip wip ON wip.wip = ml.wip WHERE ml.refno = #value#
SELECT refno AS refNo, [lineno] AS [lineNo], lotseqno AS lotSeqNo, qty, CAST(datecode AS datetime) AS dateCode FROM t_multilot_tag_detail WHERE refno = #value# ORDER BY [lineno]

SELECT d.refno AS refNo , d.[lineno] AS [lineNo] , d.lotseqno AS lotSeqNo , d.qty , CAST(d.datecode AS datetime) AS dateCode , cust.customerid AS customerId , cust.customercode AS customerCode , fg.fgid AS fgId , fg.fgno AS fgNo , fg.fgname AS fgName , lots.lotseqqty AS lotSeqQty FROM t_multilot_tag_detail d INNER JOIN t_lot_sequence lots ON lots.lotseqno = d.lotseqno INNER JOIN t_taglabel tag ON tag.tagid = lots.tagid INNER JOIN m_customer cust ON cust.customerid = tag.customerid INNER JOIN m_fg fg ON fg.fgid = tag.fgid WHERE d.refno = #value# ORDER BY d.[lineno]

SELECT d.refno AS refNo, d.lotseqno AS lotSeqNo, d.qty FROM t_multilot_tag_detail d WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) INNER JOIN t_multilot_tag ml ON ml.refno = d.refno WHERE ml.status = 'A' AND d.lotseqno IN #[]#
SELECT TOP 1 d.refno FROM t_multilot_tag_detail d INNER JOIN t_multilot_tag ml ON ml.refno = d.refno WHERE ml.status = 'A' AND d.lotseqno = #value#
SELECT fgd.lotno + '-' + fgd.lot_seqno FROM t_fg_detail fgd WHERE (fgd.lotno = LEFT(#[]#, 14) AND fgd.lot_seqno = RIGHT(#[]#, 4)) GROUP BY fgd.lotno, fgd.lot_seqno HAVING SUM(fgd.fgin) > 0
SELECT d.refno AS refNo, d.lotseqno AS lotSeqNo, d.qty FROM t_multilot_tag_detail d INNER JOIN t_multilot_tag ml ON ml.refno = d.refno WHERE ml.status = 'A' AND LEFT(d.lotseqno, 14) = #value#
SELECT snpfg FROM m_fg WHERE fgid = #value#
SELECT printdate FROM t_lotno WHERE lotno = #value#
SELECT ISNULL(SUM(fgd.fgin), 0) FROM t_multilot_tag_detail d INNER JOIN t_fg_detail fgd ON fgd.lotno = LEFT(d.lotseqno, 14) AND fgd.lot_seqno = RIGHT(d.lotseqno, 4) WHERE d.refno = #value#
sqlMap.update: UPDATE t_multilot_tag SET printcount = printcount + 1 , printername = #printerName# , updateby = #updateBy# , updatedate = GETDATE() WHERE refno = #refNo#
UPDATE t_multilot_tag SET status = 'C' , cancelby = #updateBy# , canceldate = GETDATE() , updateby = #updateBy# , updatedate = GETDATE() WHERE refno = #refNo# AND status = 'A'
